title: An Evaluation of LLMs for Detecting Harmful Computing Terms

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the zero-shot classification and contextual reasoning capabilities of various LLM architectures (encoders, decoders, and encoder-decoders) by prompting them to identify harmful or non-inclusive language across a curated database of 64 technical computing terms (e.g., "master", "slave", "blacklist", "man-in-the-middle") and their specific use cases.
